newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain- Soy up, corn mixed, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain- Soy up, corn mixed, wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were mostly higher on Monday while corn prices were mixed.
Soft red winter wheat and hard red winter wheat FOB values were unchanged.
Dealers noted quiet activity in both corn and wheat.
The continued volatility on the Chicago Board of Trade, especially the August/November soybean futures spread which widened out, contributed to the rise in FOB values, a dealer said.
On the export front, Morocco may have cancelled its 120,000 tonnes tender of optional origin wheat, several U.S. exporters said.
